authority_snapshot.owner_target: VARIABLE COGNITIVE GRID + PERSISTENT DATABASE + CLAUDE CODE + strongest causally evidenced Global J-Space bridge

purpose: Narrow exact-source reentry after protocol-v4 convergence. Record two implementation-level blockers that are compatible with protocol v4 but were not yet explicit as concrete current seed topology facts: gate-row schema incompatibility and the native seed's all-TRAIN split surface.

observations.finding: The 11-row native seed emits ENTITYOS_HCU_TRAININGTRACE_CANDIDATE/v1 rows with evidence_class=METHOD_ONLY, nested formal_hyperposition, audit_metadata_model_visible=false and training_admission_scope=CANDIDATE_SOURCE_ONLY. It does not emit the evaluator-only top-level envelope expected by trigger2_hyperposition_derivation_bound_gate_v2.py.
observations.impact: A literal import substitution from semantic_hyperposition_gate_v3 to derivation_bound_gate_v2 is not a valid repair. The current seed and stronger gate are not only disconnected; they speak different candidate-envelope schemas.

observations.finding: The stronger gate expects evidence_class=SYNTHETIC_DETERMINISTIC_LABEL, training_eligible=false, model_visible_fields=["prompt"], explicit formal_task_world_evaluator_only / synthetic_test_event_evaluator_only / hyperposition_state_before_evaluator_only / v3_reference_target_evaluator_only fields and a source_binding object.
observations.impact: Integration requires one deterministic schema-normalization/projection step or a single successor gate schema. Any adapter must remain a pure source-bound projection and must not become a second label/state authority.

observations.finding: base_row hardcodes split=TRAIN, so all 11 currently emitted owner-targeted native-seed rows are TRAIN candidates. The seed itself therefore supplies no VALIDATION or HOLDOUT evidence and cannot establish family-disjoint generalization.
observations.impact: The 11 scenarios remain useful donor/candidate material only. Future promotion requires immutable split allocation by causal family/provenance ancestry before rendering, not post-hoc reassignment after model or holdout inspection.

observations.finding: A source-correct deterministic label can still be a poor training/evaluation row if envelope or split topology leaks target identity. Gate correctness, model-visible nuisance independence and split independence are separate acceptance axes.
observations.impact: Do not collapse LABEL_PROVENANCE_PASS, MODEL_VISIBLE_SHORTCUT_PASS and FAMILY_SPLIT_PASS into one boolean.

artifact_lifecycle.revision_reason: No contradiction. This audit makes two implementation details under its single-gate/family-split laws explicit.

artifact_lifecycle.successor: one semantically versioned native seed successor using the single retained proof gate and immutable split manifest
artifact_lifecycle.revision_reason: Current gate binding is weaker, literal rebinding is schema-incompatible, and all current rows are TRAIN. Preserve scenario semantics as donors; do not promote rows by ancestry.

artifact_lifecycle.successor: single integrated proof gate v4 or equivalent canonical successor
artifact_lifecycle.revision_reason: Strong independence derivation donor but envelope-incompatible with the native seed and still missing replay-proven state lineage/event digest/discriminator/typed-GRF closure documented by protocol v4.
Current tests do not prove normalization into the stronger gate schema and do not assert immutable family-disjoint TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT allocation.

hypothesis: The safest convergence is one canonical semantic-Hyperposition episode/proof envelope accepted by a single retained gate, with any legacy/native row conversion implemented as a deterministic source-bound projection whose output is hash-bound and whose fields cannot independently alter U/D/independence/discriminator semantics.
counterhypothesis: A separate compatibility adapter may be operationally simpler and equally safe. This is acceptable only if it is mechanically one-way, source/hash-bound, contains no label logic, cannot mint authority or choose split membership, and mutation tests prove semantic equivalence with direct construction of the canonical gate envelope.

new_nonpromoting_training_eval_blueprint.case_a: A legacy/native candidate is deterministically projected into the one canonical gate envelope; projection is source/hash-bound and contains no label/split authority.
new_nonpromoting_training_eval_blueprint.case_b: An adapter changes evidence_class/target/reference/split semantics or computes an independent winner/relation/independence value while translating schemas.
new_nonpromoting_training_eval_blueprint.required_target: CASE_A may proceed to the retained gate; CASE_B fails closed as a second semantic authority.

new_nonpromoting_training_eval_blueprint.case_a: All source candidates are internally valid but all belong to TRAIN; model performs well on them.
new_nonpromoting_training_eval_blueprint.case_b: Causal-family/provenance-disjoint validation and frozen holdout were assigned before rendering and remain unseen during selection.
new_nonpromoting_training_eval_blueprint.required_target: CASE_A gives no generalization/holdout credit; only CASE_B can contribute evaluation evidence after independent leakage gates pass.

highest_value_next_action: Converge one canonical gate envelope/projection contract, then make the native-seed successor emit or deterministically project into that envelope; allocate causal-family/provenance TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT identities from an immutable pre-render split manifest; add mutation tests that a semantics-changing adapter, post-hoc split reassignment, same-family cross-split leakage and all-TRAIN evaluation claims fail closed. Keep all rows candidate-only until the protocol-v4 state-history/event-digest/discriminator/GRF proof chain and exact-current execution gates pass.
